mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ai_model_price p ON p.provider = lower(c.provider) AND p.model = c.model AND p.enabled = TRUE
p.id AS price_id, p.input_price_per_million, p.cached_input_price_per_million, p.output_price_per_million, p.cost_multiplier

count(*) AS model_call_count, coalesce(sum(c.input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(c.cached_tokens), 0) AS cached_tokens, coalesce(sum(c.output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, coalesce(sum(c.reasoning_tokens), 0) AS reasoning_tokens, coalesce(sum(c.total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens
mapper.select:
SELECT NULL::bigint AS user_id, NULL::varchar AS provider, NULL::varchar AS model, NULL::varchar AS purpose, NULL::varchar AS source, ,
FROM ai_llm_call_usage c
WHERE GROUP BY p.id, p.input_price_per_million, p.cached_input_price_per_million, p.output_price_per_million, p.cost_multiplier

SELECT c.user_id, NULL::varchar AS provider, NULL::varchar AS model, NULL::varchar AS purpose, NULL::varchar AS source, ,
FROM ai_llm_call_usage c
WHERE AND c.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.user_id, p.id, p.input_price_per_million, p.cached_input_price_per_million, p.output_price_per_million, p.cost_multiplier

SELECT NULL::bigint AS user_id, c.provider, c.model, NULL::varchar AS purpose, NULL::varchar AS source, ,
FROM ai_llm_call_usage c
WHERE GROUP BY c.provider, c.model, p.id, p.input_price_per_million, p.cached_input_price_per_million, p.output_price_per_million, p.cost_multiplier

SELECT NULL::bigint AS user_id, NULL::varchar AS provider, NULL::varchar AS model, NULL::varchar AS purpose, c.source, ,
FROM ai_llm_call_usage c
WHERE GROUP BY c.source, p.id, p.input_price_per_million, p.cached_input_price_per_million, p.output_price_per_million, p.cost_multiplier

SELECT c.provider, c.model, count(*) AS model_call_count, coalesce(sum(c.total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, max(c.started_at) AS last_seen_at FROM ai_llm_call_usage c
WHERE AND p.id IS NULL AND c.provider IS NOT NULL AND c.model IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.provider, c.model ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED', 'EXPIRED')) AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REJECTED_QUOTA') AS quota_rejected, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('ADMITTED', 'RUNNING')) AS in_progress, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status LIKE 'REJECTED_%' AND status <> 'REJECTED_QUOTA') AS other_rejected FROM ai_run_admissions WHERE created_at >= #{fromAt} AND created_at < #{toExclusive} AND user_id IS NOT NULL
